text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Casino Drive
standing still inside a convenience store near the academy.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So this counts as a "reward."
It is certainly delicious, but...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Does this act truly hold that much worth...?
Do they boost their own motivation
by granting themselves small treats...?
choice_data_list: ...Are you researching meat buns or something?
...Are you researching meat buns or something?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Trainer-san.
Actually, I am currently conducting an investigation
regarding rewards in student life.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
At present, I am forming a team with academy students
to drive a project challenging the world forward, but—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I considered that fostering team atmosphere
might be crucial to boosting motivation.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I am researching casual "methods of relaxation,"
such as buying snacks on the go.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
However, having spent long periods on overseas expeditions, I am unfamiliar
with typical school life... It has proven challenging.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I plan to tour entertainment facilities today
and conduct thorough research.
choice_data_list: Oho~ That sounds pretty interesting.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oh? In that case, would you join me?
I would appreciate opinions from a non-student perspective.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, that was obtained
much faster than expected.
choice_data_list: Casino, you're really good at crane games!
Casino, you're really good at crane games!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? It is merely a matter of aligning
the vertical and horizontal axes, but...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Perhaps the enjoyment lies
within the process of refining this technique.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Shall we vary target prize weights
and play several more varieties?
choice_data_list: (W-What a stoic way to play...)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oh, holding it in hand, it is quite impressive.
This seems like something enjoyable to eat when coming with the team.
choice_data_list: You ordered three of them, looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As part of research,
it is necessary to sample as many flavors as possible.
choice_data_list: Ah, so that's why...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
However, this is quite a lot for a light snack.
And having eaten a meat bun earlier as well...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I shall take one bite of each and take the rest home.
I will go request some dry ice.
choice_data_list: ...It'll be bulky to carry, want me to help eat them?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
That would be a great help.
Please share your feedback on taste as well.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Misete ageru, EVOLUTION~♪
GO AHEAD~, Mirai DAYS~♪

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
Alright, shall we sing it one more time?
choice_data_list: Um... isn't this the fifth time for that song?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. During Winning Live rehearsals,
we would sing continuously until fully mastered.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, if one's singing improves like this,
wouldn't their motivation for karaoke increase as well?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Let us analyze key vocal techniques.
I will share them with team to aim for higher baseline scores.
choice_data_list: Y-Yeah, sounds like a good idea...!
Y-Yeah, sounds like a good idea...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
That concludes today's research.
I believe we experienced many student-like pastimes.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
However... I am still uncertain. Will this truly
lead to relaxation for the team?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Her analysis was detailed and flawless.
Yet, one single element was missing.
choice_data_list: You want to improve the team atmosphere, right?
You want to improve the team atmosphere, right?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...? Yes, team cohesion is essential
for achieving our objectives.
choice_data_list: Then shouldn't you be enjoying it together as a team?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, because she was so thorough...
her idea of fun had become completely self-contained.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... building team atmosphere
requires perspective of "enjoying things with someone."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —! I see...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Having fun together with the other person...
I had completely overlooked that perspective.
choice_data_list: It might've been hard to notice when investigating alone.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Investigating this as a team
would yield much deeper insights.
choice_data_list: I think you'd enjoy it more that way too, Casino.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
You are right...
First, I must experience it myself...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, I will form a new team!
In order to learn the points of "enjoying things together with someone."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
As for team members...
Could I ask you to join?
choice_data_list: Eh, me?
Eh, me?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You provided me with fresh awareness...
I want to rely on that broad perspective!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
We will share findings from our pair with project...
receive feedback, and proceed with further investigation.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
With this mutual interaction, we will surely
discover effective methods for maintaining team motivation!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Entitled... the "Synergy Project"!
Please lend me your strength!
choice_data_list: Got it! Let's do our best together!
If it's about having fun together, wouldn't another horse girl be better suited?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Let us immediately hold a meeting for next investigation.
Here is my business contact info...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—No, let us exchange LANE accounts instead.
Since there will likely be many messages on days off.
choice_data_list: Thanks! Looking forward to working with you!
Thanks! Looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Through repeated investigations...
let us guide the "Synergy Project" to success!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... A sharp opinion, as expected.
That is precisely what I am seeking.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Purpose of "Synergy Project" is strictly investigation.
Analysis from outside perspective of horse girls is essential.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, your calm reasoning capacity
will certainly prove useful... What do you say?
choice_data_list: I see... If that's the case, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
As a member of the "Synergy Project"...
I look forward to working with you.
